title: Fix Python 3.14 debugpy build failure
description: Investigate and resolve the failing python3.14-debugpy test suite that blocks the Visual Studio Code Python extension in the Darwin Home Manager configuration.
acceptance_criteria: The Darwin configuration evaluates and builds past python3.14-debugpy, and the selected mitigation is verified against the affected package.
close_reason: Added the verified Nixpkgs upstream issue reference and reran validation.

comments.author: Leonard Sheng Sheng Lee
comments.text: Root cause: `ms-python.python` embeds `python3.pkgs.debugpy`, which resolves to Python 3.14.7. debugpy 1.8.22 has failing Darwin integration tests. Added a Darwin-only Python package extension that disables checks only when the package set uses Python 3.14. Verified that the affected debugpy derivation changed from `/nix/store/4w2i78...` to `/nix/store/m7c3...`, then built `.#darwinConfigurations.TP95V9LWWL.pkgs.vscode-extensions.ms-python.python` successfully.

comments.author: Leonard Sheng Sheng Lee
comments.text: Added `# @upstream-issue https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/issues/572553` above the scoped debugpy workaround. `nix flake check`, `pre-commit run --all-files`, and `git diff --check` passed.

title: Fix Nix token access on all platforms
